correctness.rationale: Exact derivatives of the point-lens magnification give \(J_2=2Sqg'(v)\), \(J_4=12Sq^2g''(v)\), and \(J_6=120Sq^3g'''(v)\). The flux-independent ratio \(R=\frac{20}{9}(1+(u_0^2+2)^{-2})\) decreases strictly from \(25/9\) to \(20/9\). Its inverse uniquely recovers the impact parameter, after which time-scale and all source/blend fluxes follow algebraically. Explicit positive-affine compensation produces a continuum of distinct models with identical fifth jets in every finite number of passbands. The full proof, exact witness, and finite arithmetic tests are in the embedded files; the tests alone cannot establish the infinite-domain theorem.

value.rationale: Resolves a motivated structural identifiability question in the standard blended microlensing model: sixth local derivative order is both necessary and sufficient in arbitrary passband counts without known source or background flux. The multi-band fifth-jet obstruction is a sharp information limit, not a restatement of finite-noise near-degeneracy. Exact reconstruction and asymptotic conditioning bound provide calibratable benchmarks, though sixth derivative estimation is numerically delicate.
